objective: Test the scope layer and the disagreement-targeted adjudication stage: classify detected boxes into primary and commentary layers deterministically, read each page once into separated primary and commentary fields with count anchors, pair the primary lines against the existing per-column channel, adjudicate only disagreeing columns on their crops, and score the assembled consensus pipeline end to end.
hypothesis: Scope separation collapses the commentary-driven CER inflation: layered primary CER improves on every two-layer page relative to the 0.443086 full-page champion, healthy one-layer pages do not regress, the assembled consensus pipeline beats the champion macro CER, and scope-correct consensus precision reaches 0.99 on healthy pages.

scope_layer.method: optimal 1-D two-split of per-page box widths; two layers only when the small cluster center is at most 0.72 of the large center and holds 15-85 percent of boxes; column tags by majority, structure asserted equal to recorded geometry
scope_layer.finding_before_paid_calls: All three catastrophic pages and all four mid-CER commentary pages classify two-layer; every healthy page classifies one-layer. Ten of 28 pages are two-layer.
scope_layer.known_imperfection: The Chu Ci page classifies 132 primary boxes against 227 gold characters, so count anchors are approximate, never hard limits.

channel_a_prime.prompt: LAYERED_PROMPT_TEMPLATE: two-field diplomatic transcription, primary versus half-width commentary, one column per line, per-page count anchors from the scope layer

dispute_stage.pairing: primary lines and primary-layer columns aligned in shared right-to-left order by similarity dynamic programming; equal no-space texts are agreed; differing pairs and column-only entries become disputes; line-only entries pass through as channel A text
dispute_stage.prompt: DISPUTE_PROMPT_TEMPLATE: column crop is sole authority, candidates framed as untrusted data, primary characters only
dispute_stage.failure_policy: gateway failures recorded as failed rows with observed usage, retried only on explicit resume; failed disputes fall back to channel A text in assembly

gates.two_layer_improvement: layered primary CER below full-page CER on at least 8 of the 10 two-layer pages
gates.healthy_non_regression: layered primary macro CER on one-layer pages within +0.02 of their full-page macro
gates.dispute_volume: stop if the pairing produces more than 320 disputes
gates.dispute_truncation: at most 2 percent of dispute calls truncated or failed
gates.pipeline_gate: assembled consensus pipeline macro CER below the 0.443086 champion
gates.consensus_target: scope-correct consensus precision at least 0.99 on healthy pages
gates.budget_stop: runner refuses the next case once observed spend reaches the maximum

non_goals: Do not edit the production recipe.
Do not modify prior experiment artifacts or gold.
Do not promote or propose any candidate from this evidence.
next_permitted_action: Run the two-page layered smoke covering one one-layer and one two-layer page, verify field separation and cost, then complete all 28 layered reads, the dispute pass, and deterministic scoring within the declared budget.
